cohort: 37 patients with SCTs admitted to pediatric surgery departments in Ramadi and Mosul city, Iraq, between December 2013 and December 2018.
finding: Early diagnosis and complete excision of SCTs are important factors affecting the outcome in the perinatal period, while the size of the primary tumor does not affect recurrence or outcome.
gest_age: 75% of the neonatal age group (28 patients) were born at full term
birth_weight: Median birth weight of 3100 g for the neonatal age group (28 patients)
